# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform reliability and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, rendering reliability, and managed allocation behavior. Apple targets now require newer operating systems, WebAssembly packages include their WebGPU implementation correctly, and common image and text-shaping paths allocate less memory.

## Breaking Changes

- **iOS and tvOS now require version 14** — The iOS and tvOS native assets and target framework metadata now require iOS 14.0 or tvOS 14.0. Update applications that support earlier operating-system versions or remain on a previous SkiaSharp release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows display refresh** — Android GL texture views synchronize rendering with the display refresh cycle for steadier presentation. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain sources** — Front-buffered managed streams release their source stream when no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies allocate less managed memory** — Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary allocations while preserving their output. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text shaping avoids temporary encoding allocations** — HarfBuzzSharp reuses buffers for UTF-32 text input and formats feature strings without native heap allocation. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Apple deployment targets are updated** — iOS and tvOS packages now target version 14.0, and native macOS binaries require macOS 11.0. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebAssembly WebGPU builds package native support** — The WebGPU C++ implementation is included in the SkiaSharp native library so .NET WebAssembly applications do not compile it during their link step. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux uses the bundled HarfBuzz symbols** — Native Linux builds bind HarfBuzz functionality from the bundled library rather than resolving it from the application environment. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
